'''Kabat''' was a noted [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] broker of illicit goods. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he worked from a base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. He didn't like [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] that stole cargoes or skipped out on deals. So, he often used harsh methods for dealing with those who tried to take advantage of him.
